paragraphs: With Zone & Co aiming to revolutionize financial operations through ERP-native AI, my experience in deploying AI agents on AWS aligns closely with your needs. I contributed to the Lambda Web Adapter, ensuring secure and efficient containerized deployments with ECR and IAM roles.

I also proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, and PostgreSQL, which I demonstrated to stakeholders in Madrid. This project showcased my ability to design and implement AI solutions directly within ERP systems.
I have not used Azure yet, but I am eager to explore its capabilities and integrate them into future projects.

Could we schedule a short call to discuss how my experience can contribute to Zone & Co's mission? I would be happy to walk you through my work on the Lambda Web Adapter and the agentic tool prototype.
